name: Dapoxetine
description: Short-acting SSRI (selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor) tablet, taken as needed before sex

note.lead: Approved in Europe, not the US.
note.text: Priligy is approved nationally in Spain (2009) and Ireland (2012) for PE in men aged 18 to 64.

bullets: **Thought to block** serotonin reuptake, per the European label
**Delays the ejaculation reflex** run by a spinal-cord centre
**In rats,** it slowed the ejaculation reflex (animal research)
Trials run by the drug’s developers

practical.halfLife: About 1.5 hours initial; about 19 hours terminal (EU label)
practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak in 1 to 2 hours; liver and kidney (CYP2D6, CYP3A4, FMO1)
practical.soldAs: Not available in the US; prescription tablets in Spain, Ireland
practical.monitored: Lying and standing blood pressure and pulse before starting

references: AEMPS, Priligy summary of product characteristics, Jun 2021
Pryor et al., Lancet, dapoxetine Phase III trials, Sep 2006
McMahon et al., J Sex Med, pooled Phase III analysis, Feb 2011
